title: Composition of normalized geometric inverse-image coefficient squares
statement: Let a,b be composable arbitrary coefficient changes, and g:T→S a scheme morphism. At T and S fix strict evaluation records for three coefficient rings, normalized transports UTij and USij, normalized ordinary geometric inverse-image records Ai for g and their derived inverse-image realizations Di [def-pur-strict-etale-coefficient-transport-interfaces, def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces]. Fix normalized inverse-image coefficient squares Vij from USij ⋙ Dj.inverse to Di.inverse ⋙ UTij. For any normalized composition records AT and AS on these transports, and every derived strict system K on S with coefficients in O1, D3.inverse.map(AS.derived.hom_K) ≫ V13.derived.hom_K equals V23.derived.hom_(US12 K) ≫ UT23.derived.map(V12.derived.hom_K) ≫ AT.derived.hom_(D1.inverse K). This is a square for one geometric inverse image; it contains no open extension, proper direct image, compactification, or compact-support projection.

source.place: Zheng, Construction 4.1, Construction 5.15 and Proposition 2.29(2); tensor/adjunction normalization underlying the coefficient composition step.

proof.text: Paste the two ordinary inverse-image coefficient squares. Evaluate at coefficient level n, forget to set sheaves, and precompose with the two successive tensor units. Use the ordinary unit equations of AT and AS and the unit normalization of V12 and V23. Both resulting maps are the inverse image under g of the same composite tensor unit. The single square V13 has exactly that value by its own normalization.

The normalized scalar adjunction says that precomposition with the composite unit is injective on module-sheaf morphisms. Faithful forgetting to set sheaves therefore gives equality of the ordinary level squares. Equality of strict-system morphisms is componentwise, so this proves equality of the entire ordinary natural transformations, including their successor transitions.

Apply the complex functor and then the localization Q to the ordinary equality. Substitute the representative equations of V12,V23,V13 and of AT,AS. Naturality moves the factorization isomorphisms to the outside, where their inverses cancel. This gives the displayed equality after precomposition by Q. Fully faithful precomposition by a localization extends equality to all derived objects. It is equality of entire system morphisms, never an inference from evaluations in derived level categories.

proof_origin.place: Interface-level tensor/adjunction argument underlying Construction 4.1 and the coefficient comparisons in Construction 5.15; generalization to the arbitrary normalized records of the assigned item, not a verbatim theorem of Zheng.
